messages.subject: Question on sampling effort
parts:
Hi there

I attempting distance analysis for the first time, using point count data on ring-necked parakeets in a park in London, UK. I have been using the R package to do this. 

I have been struggling to understand how the package deals with visits to same point multiple times.  
I have 20 points, each visited 6 times, so I have put effort as 6 (120 visits in total). When I run the model (truncated at 100m) , the output gives the covered area as 3769911, which is 120*(100^2 * pi). So it is treating each visit as a new point, even though they have the same sample label. 

I'm wondering if I am missing something with the structure of my data or the way I am writing my code. Please see below for data structure and code. Any comments much appreciated.

Many thanks
Peggy

Peggy

A partial answer:

check your data structure against the one described here

https://synergy.st-andrews.ac.uk/ds-manda/#montrave-songbird-case-study

This is a case study from Buckland et al (2015) wherein there were two visits to each point count station.
